The '''flechette torpedo''' was a new weapon developed for the [[Battle of the Corellian Queen|Battle of the ''Corellian Queen'']]. The projectiles were loaded with jagged bits of [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] packed around a core of conventional explosive. The shells would detonate and in effect become a debris field for incoming [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]], not equipped with [[Particle shield/Legends|particle shields]] to defend against material objects.

Not only did the [[New Republic Defense Force/Legends|New Republic]] forces use them to destroy enemy ships, but to track those TIEs which survived the battle. The escaping fighters actually had debris from the flechette torpedoes in their [[Titanium/Legends|titanium]]-reinforced hulls, and this debris contained hundreds of thousands of [[solid-state transponder]]s triggered by a very specific subspace signal. The transponders, conceived by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], allowed the NRDF to find [[Cronal|Lord Shadowspawn's]] base at [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]].

At some point, the Imperials managed to replicate the technology, and included them on their [[TIE/ca Punisher/Legends|TIE/IT Interdictor starfighter]] line's ordnance.
